notes.title: New Character Dynamics
notes.notes:
Hello, Even game is not in early access I am still updating it almost daily Here is steamdb's link [url=https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/?appid=1237080]SteamDb[/url]
So don't worry I am not abandoning the game any time soon. I just dont make annoucement or patch notes with every update.



Since the past few days, I am redesigning character dynamics. It changes how comic characters' stats affect your comics.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36745648/f8967c2c132ff9c8413763370f4ff3bba9358895.png[/img]

Here you can see there are now few new options relations, series, finance, popularity and films. 

[list]
[*] In relation, you can see character dynamic with his love or enemy. 
[*] Finance shows various financial stats and other options for the character, I am planning to add advertisement option for particular character over here. Also, you can sell the rights of your character(Only if any studio is interested in it). Selecting a studio with a bad reputation may result in the bad movie getting produced and in turn will negatively affect characters popularity.
[*] In popularity, you can see how much character is popular with different age groups. When you make comic there are 3 options(Children's, Teen, Mature) but when you create a character there are 5/6 different options from children to adult male etc. Overall popularity depends upon how you target audience while making the audience.
[*] Series will show you many times a certain character is used in making comics.
[/list]

As of now, I am done with relationship and series part, I will add other features soon.Also unlockables(advertisement option and universe will be available today)

notes.title: Automate Production Process
notes.notes:
Hello guys, I normally update games multiple times and write a post before calling it a day. Here are new additions in the game.

[olist]
[*] Now it is possible to automate the production process when you reach the production phase you will get prompt asking to choose if you want to self produce or not. Contractor demands 20% royalty and some money upfront depending upon the scale of the comic.
[*] Scale is now tied with unlockables(new addition) medium, large size is only available when you upgrade your office.
[*] Advertisement is now disabled at the beginning, it will unlock once certain conditions met.
[*] Monthly office cost tweaked.
[*] Monthly production upkeep cost tweaked.
[*] Review algorithm tweaked.
[*] Bug fix: Sequel name repeating.
[*] Added limit to how many characters could be added in every comic(For Creating universe).
[*] Tooltips are now disabled.
[*] A warning will generate if no copies produced.
[/olist]

notes.title: Addressing all negative reviews
notes.notes: Hello, Game launched yesterday but did not get any good reviews yet. I want to address a few issues. I agree with reviewers that some of my design choices are questionable and I did not explain many in-game mechanisms that well. But, I still believe that I can make the game much better, I already planned out roadmap but I still need your help, I am completely ok if you want to criticise game but please post what you hated and what you like to see in it. It will help me to understand and make the game much better. Thanks

notes.title: Launch and what is next
notes.notes:
Hello, Comic book tycoon will release on 19th March for $4.99 with 18% launch discount.
Please note that even game is cheap does not mean that it is low effort rip off of any game. Since beta last week many things are improved and changed in-game. Even the game is out now I do have some additional content line up. My first focus will be on balancing game so I will like to hear all of your input on that. Also if you have any suggestions please post it on forum. I hope you guys will enjoy the game.

notes.notes: Hello, My target was to release the game on 9th of march but more I play the game it feels like something is missing. I don't think it is well balanced, Also I don't want to release half baked product on steam that is why I need your help I am hosting beta on itch io. If anyone is interested in testing it please contact me. I will send them demo-key.
